The morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he would check the shift template and have support test it with the store login.
- **What I couldn't find:** there's no site code or address for Pine Crossing in #central-team, the shared files, or GBrain. So I only confirmed the store name. I suggested the rollout tracker or the store ops list if the account sheet needs a site ID.

I only used sources Pree can see: #central-team, which they're in, the public files, and the GBrain copy of that same channel conversation.
